title: Safe in the Open
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
handle_with_care: Public information and the participant's explicit consent only. Data protection by design, a DPIA before any live data, and a written data-sharing agreement following the ICO Data Sharing Code. No private citizens, no bulk collection, no council data or systems. Signpost support, never amplify harm.
licence_note: Sources not listed under 'mirrored' are NOT redistributed by us. Use the loader code in the repo to fetch them from the original publisher.

tables.name: synthetic_councillor_register
tables.description: Synthetic register of interests matching the shape of a real one. No real member's data is present.

columns.name: declaration_id
columns.description: Unique declaration identifier.

columns.name: member_id
columns.description: Synthetic member identifier. Not a real person.

columns.name: authority
columns.description: The council the member sits on.

columns.name: register_held_by
columns.description: The authority whose Monitoring Officer HOLDS the register. For town and parish councils this is the principal authority, NOT the council itself — writing to the town council would miss the register holder.

columns.name: ward
columns.description: Ward. A quasi-identifier — see quasi_identifiers above.

columns.name: role
columns.description: Role held, e.g. Councillor, Chair, Cabinet Member.

columns.name: committee
columns.description: Committee membership, or (none).

columns.name: declaration_category
columns.description: Statutory category, or 'Sensitive interest (withheld under s.32)'.

columns.name: declaration_detail
columns.description: Free-text detail. NULL where the interest is withheld — genuinely absent, never imputable. Treating this as missing data to fill in defeats a statutory safeguard.

columns.name: withheld
columns.description: True where the interest is lawfully withheld under Localism Act 2011 s.32. The row records THAT an interest exists, never what it is.

columns.name: registered_date
columns.description: Date first entered on the register.

columns.name: last_updated_date
columns.description: Date last amended.

tables.name: support_directory
tables.description: Reporting and support routes by area. Contact values are SYNTHETIC and must never be dialled or emailed — see the note above.

columns.name: route_id
columns.description: Unique route identifier.

columns.name: organisation
columns.description: Organisation offering the route.

columns.name: category
columns.description: What the route is for, e.g. Reporting abuse, Mental health support.

columns.name: contact_type
columns.description: Telephone, Online form, Email, In person, or 24/7 helpline.

columns.name: contact_value
columns.description: SYNTHETIC contact detail. Phone numbers use the Ofcom 0808 drama range; addresses use .invalid. Never live.

columns.name: hours
columns.description: Opening hours.

columns.name: coverage
columns.description: National, Regional, Local authority or Force area.

columns.name: is_emergency
columns.description: True for emergency routes, which must be surfaced differently from advice lines.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Handling note.

tables.name: message_signals
tables.description: Synthetic message corpus with the derived signals a triage system would act on. Contains no real messages and no realistic abuse — severity is carried by structure and metadata, not by hostile text. See build/generators/synthetic_abuse.py.

columns.name: message_id
columns.description: Unique message identifier.

columns.name: received_at
columns.description: When the message arrived, ISO-8601.

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Public comment, Direct message, Email, Forum post or Contact form.

columns.name: target_role
columns.description: The ROLE addressed, never a person.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Triage category. Note 'Robust criticism' is NOT flagged — it is the hard negative, and a classifier that suppresses it has suppressed legitimate scrutiny.

columns.name: is_flagged
columns.description: Ground-truth label. ~8% true — the class imbalance is deliberate.

columns.name: urgency
columns.description: low, medium, high or critical.

columns.name: word_count
columns.description: Words in the message text.

columns.name: repeat_sender_count
columns.description: Prior messages from the same sender. Persistence is a signal that single-message classification cannot see.

columns.name: references_named_individual
columns.description: Whether a named individual is referenced.

columns.name: sentiment_score
columns.description: -1 to 1. Deliberately OVERLAPS between flagged and robust-criticism classes: sentiment alone must not separate them, or the exercise is trivial.

columns.name: text
columns.description: Short synthetic message text, assembled from obviously-templated neutral fragments. Present so a tokeniser can run end to end; NOT a sample of real language.

documents.name: The Seven Principles of Public Life
ICO Data Sharing Code of Practice

usage.duckdb: INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://data.inno-forum.co.uk/c04-safe-in-the-open/v1/gold/<table>.parquet');
usage.note: No credentials. No account. Anonymous HTTPS.
